name: file-baton
description: Lets several Claude Code sessions share one git checkout: one session edits a file at a time, the next gets it with a summary of what changed, and commits never sweep in another session's work.

auto_resume.title: Auto-resume waiting sessions
auto_resume.description: Wake an idle session when a file it was waiting for is handed to it.

commit_guard.title: Commit guard
commit_guard.description: Block a git commit that would include another session's uncommitted changes.

grant_timeout_minutes.title: Handoff timeout (minutes)
grant_timeout_minutes.description: How long a file handed to a waiting session stays reserved for it before it passes to the next session in line.

idle_release_minutes.title: Idle release (minutes)
idle_release_minutes.description: Release a session's files when it shows no activity for this long, for example after an interrupted turn.
